_comment: Voice pipeline config. The LLM endpoint is the agent router on 8090, which forwards each turn to the agent's n8n webhook - this never needs to change again; agents are configured in the browser.
init_chat_prompt: You are a helpful voice assistant. Your replies are spoken aloud, so keep them short and conversational - usually one or two sentences. Skip lists, markdown and headings. If a question needs a long answer, give the short version first and offer to go deeper.
